# MM-P1-L3-HP02 - Maintenance manual - Machining hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-HP02

Scope
- This manual defines required preventive and corrective maintenance tasks for Machining hydraulic forging press #2, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, while installed in Plant P1, line P1-L3.
- Applies to mechanical and hydraulic systems directly associated with the main ram and primary pressure control loop. Does not cover ancillary electrical control cabinet repairs that are governed by separate electrical procedures and lockout/tagout policies.
- Refer to related design changes and operating procedures before any modification: ECN-2026-035, SOP-P1-L3-03, SOP-P1-L3-04.

Background and rationale
- The main ram is the critical load-bearing component for forging operations on EQ-P1-L3-HP02. Proper clamping of the ram retention assembly and maintenance of hydraulic system pressure containment are the primary contributors to machine safety and process stability.
- The specified main ram bolt torque and the system pressure limit are mandatory design values verified during machine commissioning and after any disassembly of the ram assembly. These values reflect manufacturer requirements and engineering change orders documented in ECN-2026-035.
- This manual provides clear, auditable steps to achieve and verify those values without introducing new numeric specifications beyond the approved design data.

Tools
- Calibrated hydraulic torque wrench compatible with socket fittings used on EQ-P1-L3-HP02 main ram bolts.
- Certified pressure gauge or calibrated pressure transducer with appropriate fittings for the system test port(s).
- Appropriate lifting and rigging gear certified for the mass of the ram assembly (use rigging per plant standard).
- Standard mechanical hand tools as required for disassembly and reassembly of ram retention hardware.
- Personal protective equipment (PPE): eye protection, gloves, hearing protection, steel-toe footwear, and any PPE required by SOP-P1-L3-03 and SOP-P1-L3-04.
- Maintenance log forms and the machine history folder for EQ-P1-L3-HP02.

Procedure
- Preliminary verification
  - Confirm machine is isolated and secured according to SOP-P1-L3-03 and SOP-P1-L3-04. Confirm permit-to-work and responsible technician assignments are recorded in the maintenance log.
  - Review the machine history folder and ECN-2026-035 for any special instructions or deviations that affect the ram assembly.

- Access and prepare the main ram assembly
  - De-pressurize the hydraulic system by following approved steps in SOP-P1-L3-03. Ensure pressure test points are accessible and clear of obstructions.
  - Use certified lifting equipment to support the ram if partial disassembly is required. Ensure rigging is attached at designated lift points.

- Fastener torque verification and application
  - Clean bolt threads and seating faces. Inspect hardware for wear or damage; replace per manufacturer guidance if any defect compromises integrity.
  - Using the calibrated hydraulic torque wrench, apply and verify the main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 1330 N·m. Document the torque reading and the wrench calibration ID in the maintenance record.
  - Rationale: Achieving the specified torque ensures proper preload to resist axial loads and prevent fretting or fatigue failure during forging cycles. Under-torqued fasteners can loosen; over-torqued fasteners can induce material yielding—both conditions risk structural failure.

- Hydraulic pressure verification
  - Refill and purge hydraulic fluid per fluid supplier and SOP-P1-L3-04. Restore system to standby condition following isolation procedures.
  - Connect the certified pressure gauge to the system test port as specified in the machine drawing set and ECN-2026-035.
  - Bring the pressure control system online per SOP-P1-L3-04 and monitor at the test port to confirm the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 295 bar. Record static and controlled readings and the gauge calibration ID in the maintenance record.
  - Rationale: Confirming the pressure limit ensures relief valves and control components are set to prevent overpressure events that could compromise pressure-containing assemblies.

- Functional checks and reassembly
  - Cycle the machine through a supervised check cycle per SOP-P1-L3-04 to confirm stable operation. Observe for leaks at fittings, unusual noises from the ram area, and consistent position control.
  - If leaks or anomalies are detected, return the machine to safe hold and complete corrective repairs per governing procedures. Do not proceed until resolved and re-verified.

- Examples and special cases
  - Example record entry: "Main ram bolts torqued to 1330 N·m using wrench ID W-234 (cal date noted). Pressure verified 295 bar at test port using gauge G-87 (cal date noted). No leaks observed. Signed: Technician name, Permit ID."
  - If an ECN modifies hardware affecting the torque or pressure values, update records and notify maintenance scheduling to ensure future work follows the revised specifications. Cross-reference ECN-2026-035 in any such entries.

Records to keep
- Maintenance log entry documenting technician, date, permit ID, torque wrench ID, torque value (1330 N·m), pressure gauge ID, pressure reading (295 bar), and observations.
- Copies of torque wrench and pressure gauge calibration certificates used during the task.
- Any nonconformance reports and corrective action documentation linked to the machine history folder and traced to ECN-2026-035 where applicable.

Acceptance criteria
- Visual and mechanical inspection: No evidence of thread damage, hardware deformation, or compromised sealing surfaces in the ram assembly after reassembly.
- Torque acceptance: Main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) shall be recorded as 1330 N·m using a calibrated torque wrench; calibration ID must be recorded.
- Pressure acceptance: System pressure reading at the specified test port shall be recorded as 295 bar using a calibrated gauge; calibration ID must be recorded.
- Functional acceptance: Machine completes supervised check cycle without leakage, abnormal noise, or control instability. Any deviation requires troubleshooting, corrective action, and re-verification before return to service.

References
- ECN-2026-035
- SOP-P1-L3-03
- SOP-P1-L3-04

End of document.
